summary: Bitzero Holdings Inc., a foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K reporting a material change: it fully repaid its senior secured loan with JGB Collateral LLC on August 6, 2026. The repayment comprised approximately US$22,375,000 principal plus US$45,699.69 interest, discharging the loan and releasing liens on assets in Norway and North Dakota. Funding came from a private placement of special warrants closed July 30, 2026, raising ~US$24,770,454. This is a routine debt repayment, not a special situation. No restructuring or strategic event; no deal terms applicable.
